scope: The 16 approved findings from the focus-quality audit, not certification of every focus or modifier in the mod.

cases.title: Soviet financial units
cases.change: Interest rewards now use percentage points: banks -0.25 pp; Open Gates -0.10 pp. Runtime, tooltip and design preview agree.

cases.title: DDR internal factions
cases.change: Military-industry effects target the initialized industrial_conglomerates faction. Procurement faction changes occur only after actual settlement.

cases.title: DDR debt repayment
cases.change: Pay and retire the smaller of 3% GDP or remaining debt. No new borrowing or unfunded reward. A funded, once-only settlement grants -0.25 pp interest for 730 days, +8% sanction resistance and the stated political effects.

cases.title: Egyptian programme gates
cases.change: 46 repeated debate/accounting connectors merged; six distinct shared historical or constitutional entries retained. Original reward guards and prerequisite alternatives preserved. Party roots remain at their original row.

cases.title: DDR political narratives
cases.change: Seven priority political, financial and procurement descriptions now explain their programmes in English; canonical design, page and live text match.

cases.title: DDR Soviet procurement
cases.change: The import route requests 90 real Soviet stock tanks for 1% frozen DDR GDP. Assembly requires an actual Soviet licence, costs 1.6% GDP, and grants two military factories plus 3% military factory productivity only on settlement. Soviet consent, stock, designs, cash and capacity are rechecked. No future tank technology is unlocked.

cases.title: Libyan capstone
cases.change: The 70-day capstone always calls native healthcare advancement, including its 150 PP maximum-tier fallback. It also grants +3% stability and -5% healthcare costs for 730 days.

cases.title: Iraqi prisoner review
cases.change: Only living unresolved cases inside their rescue windows remain actionable. One 30 PP session and a frozen 0.5% GDP invoice; invalidated sessions refund PP once without charging cash or applying the negotiation penalty.

cases.title: Libyan descriptions
cases.change: 67 descriptions rewritten as historical programmes instead of raw effect catalogues or implementation metadata.

cases.title: Israeli descriptions
cases.change: 20 party finales and 80 follow-through entries receive individual English narratives. Existing rewards and disabled-path safeguards retained.

cases.title: Greek, Cypriot and US descriptions
cases.change: 821 curated English descriptions: 313 Greece, 295 Cyprus and 213 USA. The 16 existing US Gulf additions are preserved.

cases.title: Greek military connectors
cases.change: The air opening grants 25 Air XP instead of repeated PP. Its radar follow-up costs 0.25% GDP and builds only with funding and capacity. The empty navy connector is bypassed and its successor requirements rewired.

cases.title: Cypriot incumbent entry
cases.change: Makarios administrative programme is directly reachable: 35 days, +3% stability factor and -5% bureaucracy costs for 0.25% GDP, once and only for the correct governing party.

cases.title: Focus requirements UI
cases.change: Internal routing, scenario and redundant receipt checks hidden while real guards remain. Meaningful party and membership requirements stay visible; Nixon presidency and the 20 January 1973 deadline are named.

cases.title: Generic two-office projects
cases.change: Eleven projects deliver two office/power-plant phases, including in a single-state country. Each completed phase is charged once; unavailable phases stay pending. Existing net prices are preserved and the separate infrastructure invoice remains separate. No periodic global callback added.

cases.title: Generic military narratives
cases.change: 64 individual descriptions: 58 army, navy and air entries plus six R&D precursors. Existing military rewards and the 70-day Air Cavalry research programme retained.
